text: Raj Bhir (Lodhran) Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Raj Bhir (Lodhran) Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Punjab District: Lodhran Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1st - 5th Century CE Description: An archaeological site in ruined condition encroached by modern housed on northern side. The pottery collected from the surface was of dull red ware and included forms like water pitchers, cooking vessels, dishes, bowls, carinated lids, shards with applied rope design, shards of bowls on disc base. The stamped motifs included spoked wheel design, circular design with three circles with a dot in the middle having outer edge rayed have been reported.
